task: There is 10x-genomics single cell CellRanger data with RNA-seq and TCR-seq (contig annotations) data for blood (*B samples), tumor (*T samples) and normal tumor-adjacent tissue (*N samples) for different patients. Load the data, perform quality control. Combine all samples and keep only cells present in both the RNA-seq and TCR-seq data. Apply normalization, HVG selection (5000), PCA and neighbourhood graph (n=15) to RNA data. Keep only alpha/beta T cells with at least one productive alpha and one productive beta chain and at most two of each. Define clonotypes by nucleotide sequence identity of both chains, using only the primary receptor chains for cells with more than one alpha or beta chain. Define clonotype clusters by CDR3 amino-acid similarity (TCRdist <= 15 on both chains; a cell with two receptor pairs joins a cluster if either pair matches). Calculate clonotype modularity of the clonotype clusters on the neighbour graph. What is the mean per-cell modularity of the ET3 sample? Among cells from blood samples, which clonotype cluster has the highest modularity: what are its modularity score and FDR-adjusted p-value? Is gene FGFBP2 more or less expressed in that cluster than in all other cells ("more" or "less")? Test clonotype imbalance between tumor (case) and normal (control) cells using nucleotide clonotypes, with samples as replicates, and take the 3 with the lowest p-value. How many of them correspond (on cellular level) primarily to tumor tissues?
